channel.description: Latest articles from The Old House Life (theoldhouselife.com)

item.title: Look inside! That closet is amazing! Two acres in Mississippi. $325,000
item.description: This house has a lot of amazing details! I want that closet! The pool is nice too. This seems like a lot of house for the money! The house was built in 1933. It is located on two acres in Ruleville, Mississippi. The house features a porte cochere, beautiful crystal chandelier, wood floors, built-ins, original windows, knotty pine, french doors, arched entryways, breakfast room, game room, amazing master bathroom and a huge master closet. Outside there is a large pool and poolhouse. Four bedrooms

item.title: Long driveway! Spacious kitchen! Almost two acres in North Carolina. $295,000
item.description: Love the long driveway with this property! The kitchen looks spacious. The house was built in 1912. It is located on 1.75 acres in Troy, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, some wood flooring, spacious kitchen, coffered ceiling, baseboards and updated bathrooms. There are a couple of outbuildings on the property. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,373 square feet. $295,000 Contact Jay Ross with Keller Williams Select: jayross@kw.com From the Zillow listing: This two story

item.title: Love the outbuildings! Over four acres in Virginia. $279,900
item.description: Nice outbuildings! Pretty setting! The house was built in 1870. It is located on 4.21 acres in Willis, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, wainscoting, baseboards, crown moulding, updated kitchen and an updated bathroom. There are multiple outbuildings on the property. Wish they showed inside them. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,334 square feet. $279,900 Contact Darin Greear with Long and Foster – New River Valley: 540-320-5859 From the Zillow listing: Enjoy coun

item.title: Spanish Eclectic house in Missouri. C. 1927. $95,000
item.description: A Spanish Eclectic style home. Interesting how there are quite a few on this street in Missouri. The house was built in 1927. It is located in Joplin, Missouri. The Spanish Eclectic-Revival home features a stucco exterior, softly rounded parapets, arched entryways, wood floors, clay accent and a brick fireplace. There is a large unfinished basement, fenced in backyard and a detached storage shed. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 842 square feet. $95,000 Contact Ryan Flanagan with Indi Real Estate:

item.title: Nice wine cellar! Circa 1926 in Nebraska. $220,000
item.description: This house has a nice wine cellar! The house was built in 1926. It is located on .33 acre in Beatrice, Nebraska. The house features a small covered porch, sturdy looking staircase, original wood floors, baseboards, built-ins, original wood doors and a built-in china cabinet. There is a large basement with a wine cellar. There is a detached garage and a large fenced in backyard. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,738 square feet. $220,000 Contact Tessa Mangnall with Woods Bros Realty: 402-429-503

item.title: Over an acre in the NC mountains! 15 minutes to Boone. $279,000
item.description: This is such a pretty area of the North Carolina mountains! Only 15 minutes from Boone. The house was built in 1938. It is located on 1.25 acres in Deep Gap, North Carolina. The house features two covered porches, a small fenced in area for pets, some wood flooring, updated kitchen, stone fireplace, bead board and a claw foot tub. I dislike the trendy barn doors. There is a detached building on the property. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 704 square feet. $279,000 Contact Paige Pennington wit

item.title: Diamond in the Rough! Over four acres in Virginia. $115,000
item.description: This house looks like a diamond in the rough! Lots of potential! The house was built in 1940. It is located on 4.08 acres in Reedville, Virginia. I wish they included more pictures. Would love to see more of the property. The house definitely looks livable, so someone could move in and work room by room. Close to the Reedville Fisherman’s Museum. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 980 square feet. $115,000 Contact John Jones with RE/MAX Waterfront Property From the Zillow listing: 3 bedroom 1 bath

item.title: Check out the toilet! This has character! Five acres in New Hampshire. $450,000
item.description: This house has character! How about that toilet! The house was built in 1875. It is located on five acres in Marlborough, New Hampshire. The house features a covered porch, wide plank wood floors, built-in shelving, wainscoting, french doors, built-in china cabinet and a claw foot tub. Four bedrooms, four bathrooms and 2,713 square feet. $450,000 Contact Bruce Murphy with Keller Willams Realty: 603-352-0514 From the Zillow listing: Step into the timeless character of this 1875 New Englander farm

item.title: Huge kitchen! Almost five acres in New York. C. 1835. $274,900
item.description: This house has a huge kitchen! Nice acreage too. The house was built in 1835. It is located on 4.9 acres in Macedon, New York. The house features a small covered front porch, wood floors, baseboards, crown moulding, exposed beams, built-in shelving, really spacious kitchen, updated bathrooms and wide plank flooring upstairs. There is a detached garage on the property. Five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,762 square feet. $274,900 Contact Jeffrey Scofield with RE/MAX From the Zillow listing: Histor

item.title: Love the library! Circa 1874 in Ohio. $570,000
item.description: I love the library in this house! And this is a large home with over 4,000 square feet of living space. The house was built in 1874. It is located on .47 acre in Hamilton, Ohio. The house features tall ceilings, covered side porch, wood floors, crown moulding, chair rails, french doors, library, floor to ceiling windows and an updated kitchen. The property has an in-ground pool and a hot tub. Six bedrooms, seven bathrooms and 4,628 square feet. $570,000 Contact Josh Hershner with Plum Tree Realt
